name: Prof. (Dr.) Nitin Rakesh
department: Symbiosis Institute of Technology (SIT), Nagpur
bio:
**Dr. Nitin** is a **professionally acclaimed leader in AI, Policy, and Governance in Higher Education**, and a widely respected **Keynote Speaker and Higher Education Leader** with extensive experience in academic leadership, research excellence, teaching innovation, institutional governance, and industry–academia collaboration. He is recognized for his strategic contributions to **policy-driven education reforms, technology-enabled governance frameworks**, and the **integration of artificial intelligence** in academic planning, quality assurance, and outcome-based education.

He is a proud recipient of the **IBM Drona Award**, a prestigious honor recognizing excellence in teaching, academic leadership, and impactful contributions to education and research.Dr. Nitin is an active member of several internationally reputed professional societies.

He is a **Senior Member of IEEE (USA)** and a professional member of **ACM** and **SIAM (USA)**. He also holds **Life Membership of the Computer Society of India (CSI)** and is associated with multiple national and international professional bodies, contributing to academic governance, research dissemination, curriculum design, and professional development initiatives.
office_location: Academic Block A, SIT Nagpur Campus
